context: A uni student interviews a retired farmer
purpose: Teach: 肥料/農産物/発動/保安/勤労/教徒/陳述/軍人

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 長年、農業に携わってこられたんですよね。
lines.en: You've been working in agriculture for a long time, haven't you?
lines.style: Respectful and curious. Lean forward slightly. Warm pace—not rushed. A genuine question from someone genuinely interested in hearing the answer.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん。肥料の質と農産物の出来、密接につながっている。
lines.en: Yes. The quality of the soil and fertilizer—it directly shapes how well the crop turns out.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, grounded. Speak from experience without needing to perform authority. Steady, unhurried pace. The tone of someone who has learned this through decades of work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 保安基準の発動、現場では大変でしたか。
lines.en: Those new regulations—were they difficult to implement out in the fields?
lines.style: Thoughtful probe. Gentle but direct. Pause before asking, as if you're genuinely trying to understand the weight of it. Slight lean-in on the question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 勤労意欲の高い若者ほど、丁寧に取り組んでくれた。
lines.en: The young people with real drive—they picked up the new practices without complaint. They understood why it mattered.
lines.style: Warm observation. A small smile in the voice. Not lecturing, but reflecting on something that moved you. Slow, appreciative pace. Slight exhale of quiet pride.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域の教徒の方々との関わり、強かったんですか。
lines.en: Did you have strong ties with people in the community?
lines.style: Open, inviting question. Slightly softer tone—asking permission to understand more. Curious but not prying. Natural conversational pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん。退役軍人会の支援も受け、陳述書を集めた経験もある。
lines.en: Yes. We had support from the veterans' association—I even gathered written accounts from people over the years.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant—looking back. Deliberate pace. Each phrase lands separately, like remembering. Quiet, steady voice. The tone of someone at peace with what was done.
